title: Daddy Puts up a Picture
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig, this is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇，这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig!
Daddy puts up a picture.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig have a new picture of Peppa and George.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸有佩奇和乔治的新照片。

lines.en: We should put this lovely new picture on the wall.
lines.zh: 我们应该把这张可爱的新照片挂在墙上。

lines.en: Leave it to me, I am the DIY expert of the house.
lines.zh: 交给我吧，我是家里的DIY专家。

lines.en: Are you sure you can do it?
Of course, I'll just put a nail in the wall and hang the picture on it.
lines.zh: 当然，我只是在墙上钉一个钉子，然后把照片挂在上面。

lines.en: Very good, I'm just off to visit Granny and Grandpa Pig.
lines.zh: 很好，我要去看看奶奶和猪爷爷了。

lines.en: I'll see you later, and please don't make a mess.
Mess?
Goodbye, goodbye.
Daddy, can we help put up the picture?
lines.zh: 爸爸，我们可以帮忙贴张照片吗？

lines.en: You can watch, and then you'll learn how to do it properly.
lines.zh: 你可以观看，然后你就会学会如何正确地做到这一点。

lines.en: First, I need a tape measure, and a pencil.
lines.zh: 首先，我需要一个卷尺和一支铅笔。

lines.en: That is where I'm going to put the nail.
lines.zh: 那就是我要钉钉子的地方。

lines.en: Don't break the wall, Daddy.
Now I need a hammer and a nail.
lines.zh: 现在我需要一把锤子和一颗钉子。

lines.en: Stand back, children, and watch a craftsman at work.
lines.zh: 孩子们，退后一步，观看工匠的工作。

lines.en: Daddy Pig is going to knock the nail into the wall.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸要把钉子敲到墙上。

lines.en: Don't break the wall, Daddy.
Don't be silly, Peppa.
Easy as pie.
Oh, it's not meant to do that.
Daddy Pig has made a big crack in the wall.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸把墙上弄出了一条大裂缝。

lines.en: Oh, Daddy, you've broken the wall.
It's just a tiny crack.
lines.zh: 这只是一个微小的裂缝。

lines.en: The picture will hide it.
There.
I can still see the crack, Daddy.
lines.zh: 我仍然可以看到裂缝，爸爸。

lines.en: Yes, I'll just take the nail out and fill in the crack.
lines.zh: 是的，我只要把钉子拿出来，填上裂缝就可以了。

lines.en: Don't make a mess, Daddy.
Don't be silly, Peppa.
Oh, it's coming out.
Oh, Daddy, now you really have broken the wall.
lines.zh: 噢，爸爸，你现在真的打破了墙。

lines.en: Hmm.
Do you think Mummy will notice?
lines.zh: 你觉得妈妈会注意到吗？

lines.en: Yes, I think she might.
Quick, George.
What are they doing?
Daddy, we can see you.
lines.zh: 爸爸，我们可以见到你了。

lines.en: Daddy Pig has to mend the wall before Mummy Pig comes home.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸必须在猪妈妈回家之前把墙修好。

lines.en: Brick please.
First Daddy Pig fills the hole with bricks.
lines.zh: 第一个猪爸爸用砖块填满了洞。

lines.en: There.
Next Daddy Pig puts plaster over the bricks.
lines.zh: 接下来猪爸爸给砖块抹灰。

lines.en: Easy as pie.
Then Daddy Pig paints the wall.
Good as new.
The wall is mended.
But look at all the mess they have made.
lines.zh: 但是看看他们弄得一团糟。

lines.en: Goodness me, we'd better clean up before Mummy comes back.
lines.zh: 天哪，我们最好在妈妈回来之前清理干净。

lines.en: Daddy Pig quickly washes Peppa and George.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸赶紧给佩奇和乔治洗澡。

lines.en: Then Peppa vacuums the floor and Daddy Pig tidies up the tools.
lines.zh: 然后佩奇用吸尘器吸地板，猪爸爸收拾工具。

lines.en: Mummy!
Mummy Pig is home.
Mummy!
Mummy's here.
Quick, pretend nothing has happened.
lines.zh: 快点，假装什么都没发生。

lines.en: Hello.
Hello.
What have you been doing?
Oh, nothing.
Yes, I can see you've been doing nothing.
lines.zh: 是的，我看得出你什么也没做。

lines.en: I thought you were going to put the picture up.
lines.zh: 我以为你会把照片放上去。

lines.en: In all the excitement, Daddy Pig has forgotten to put the picture up.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸一兴奋，忘记把照片放上来了。

lines.en: Oh.
Well, I'm no expert, but I'm sure it's quite easy.
lines.zh: 嗯，我不是专家，但我确信这很简单。

lines.en: Yes, that did look quite easy.
lines.zh: 是的，这看起来确实很简单。

lines.en: But when you did it, Daddy, it looked really hard.
lines.zh: 但是当你这么做的时候，爸爸，看起来真的很难。

lines.en: Shush, Peppa, don't tell anyone.
